purpose: Define the mandatory close checklist for future Tokenoskobi work units so runtime state, git state, root hygiene and kernel outputs cannot drift silently.
scope: Control-plane checklist only. No feature work, no CORE upgrade, no root artifact creation.

mandatory_checks.git_status_pre_close: Must know whether workspace is clean or only expected closure files changed.
mandatory_checks.project_runtime_updated: PROJECT_RUNTIME.json must reflect the closed work unit before declaring closure.
mandatory_checks.tk_ai: tk ai must run without error.
mandatory_checks.tk_machine: tk machine must run without error.
mandatory_checks.graphs_non_null: All tk machine graph values must be non-null.
mandatory_checks.root_hygiene: No generated artifacts may appear in repository root.
mandatory_checks.commit_push: Closure changes must be committed and pushed.
mandatory_checks.tk_sync: Local and remote heads must match after push.
mandatory_checks.runtime_head_match: PROJECT_RUNTIME.json git.head and current_head must equal git HEAD after closure.
mandatory_checks.next_safe_step_ready: next_safe_step.status must be READY after closure unless a real blocker remains.
